system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud KMS key ring and a key for encrypting Cloud Storage objects.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud KMS key ring and a key for encrypting Cloud Storage objects.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: kms.jinja

resources:
- name: kms-deployment
  type: kms.jinja
  properties:
    projectId: my-project-id
    location: us-central1
    keyRingName: storage-encryption-keyring
    cryptoKeyName: storage-encryption-key
    rotationPeriodSeconds: 7776000s
    nextRotationOffsetSeconds: 86400
    keyPurpose: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
    algorithm: GOOGLE_SYMMETRIC_ENCRYPTION
    protectionLevel: SOFTWARE
    bucketName: my-encrypted-storage-bucket
    storageLocation: US
    storageClass: STANDARD
    versioningEnabled: true
    uniformBucketLevelAccess: true
    publicAccessPrevention: enforced
    storageServiceAccount: service-PROJECT_NUMBER@gs-project-accounts.iam.gserviceaccount.com

outputs:
- name: keyRingId
  value: $(ref.kms-deployment.keyRingId)
- name: cryptoKeyId
  value: $(ref.kms-deployment.cryptoKeyId)
- name: bucketName
  value: $(ref.kms-deployment.bucketName)

---
# kms.jinja
resources:
{% set keyRingId = 'projects/' ~ properties['projectId'] ~ '/locations/' ~ properties['location'] ~ '/keyRings/' ~ properties['keyRingName'] %}
{% set cryptoKeyId = keyRingId ~ '/cryptoKeys/' ~ properties['cryptoKeyName'] %}

- name: {{ properties['keyRingName'] }}
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ properties['projectId'] }}/locations/{{ properties['location'] }}
    keyRingId: {{ properties['keyRingName'] }}

- name: {{ properties['cryptoKeyName'] }}
  type: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys
  properties:
    parent: $(ref.{{ properties['keyRingName'] }}.name)
    cryptoKeyId: {{ properties['cryptoKeyName'] }}
    purpose: {{ properties['keyPurpose'] }}
    rotationPeriod: {{ properties['rotationPeriodSeconds'] }}
    nextRotationTime:
      seconds: {{ properties['nextRotationOffsetSeconds'] }}
    versionTemplate:
      algorithm: {{ properties['algorithm'] }}
      protectionLevel: {{ properties['protectionLevel'] }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ properties['keyRingName'] }}

- name: {{ properties['cryptoKeyName'] }}-iam-binding
  action: gcp-types/cloudkms-v1:cloudkms.projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys.setIamPolicy
  properties:
    resource: {{ cryptoKeyId }}
    policy:
      bindings:
      - role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
        members:
        - serviceAccount:{{ properties['storageServiceAccount'] }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ properties['cryptoKeyName'] }}

- name: {{ properties['bucketName'] }}
  type: storage.v1.bucket
  properties:
    name: {{ properties['bucketName'] }}
    location: {{ properties['storageLocation'] }}
    storageClass: {{ properties['storageClass'] }}
    versioning:
      enabled: {{ properties['versioningEnabled'] }}
    iamConfiguration:
      uniformBucketLevelAccess:
        enabled: {{ properties['uniformBucketLevelAccess'] }}
      publicAccessPrevention: {{ properties['publicAccessPrevention'] }}
    encryption:
      defaultKmsKeyName: {{ cryptoKeyId }}
    lifecycle:
      rule:
      - action:
          type: SetStorageClass
          storageClass: NEARLINE
        condition:
          age: 30
      - action:
          type: SetStorageClass
          storageClass: COLDLINE
        condition:
          age: 90
      - action:
          type: Delete
        condition:
          age: 365
          isLive: false
    logging:
      logBucket: {{ properties['bucketName'] }}-logs
      logObjectPrefix: access-logs/
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
    - {{ properties['cryptoKeyName'] }}-iam-binding

outputs:
- name: keyRingId
  value: {{ keyRingId }}
- name: cryptoKeyId
  value: {{ cryptoKeyId }}
- name: bucketName
  value: {{ properties['bucketName'] }}
